statement: At a collapsing level the construction of Lemma 8.3 supplies data at the next level satisfying all the stated invariants. More precisely, with the CY discrepancy C = A′ + xH = aK + MC, put (8.9) A+ next = π#A+ , Qnext = π#(C − xπ∗ HV ), λnext = x−1 , Snext = V, Hnext = HV . Then Λnext = x−1π#C, λnext ≍ s → 0, and snext ≳ s. The CY moduli of A+ next have a bounded b-Cartier multiple, and Qnext has a uniform positive discrepancy bound on every prime over V .
